_comment: Hand-reviewed facts about seat holds that no feed provides, read by scripts/build_seat_holds.py. Each entry names one hold by legisGaGovId + seatId and supplies only what is missing (today: why a hold ended). Every entry needs a _note saying how it was confirmed and _sources with at least one URL; the build refuses an entry without them, or one that matches no hold. endedBy records only why THIS hold ended (docs/seat-history-design.md, Date semantics). Holds on a seat a later map redrew end 'redistricted' automatically and need no entry; 2025-26 departures come from ga-members-overrides.json.
